tweet.text:
You cannot call this “independent” with a straight face and ignore the fact that someone who just left Anthropic now works at METR.

That is exactly the kind of revolving-door conflict an independent investigation is supposed to be insulated from.

So spell it out. Who is recused? Who chose the investigators? Who controls access? Who reviews the findings? Who audits METR?

“Trust us, we’re independent” is not independence. It’s the claim that needs auditing.
